ctx: 영화 「The Shawshank Redemption」(1994, Frank Darabont, from Stephen King's novella). Tim Robbins as Andy Dufresne, a young banker convicted in 1947 of murdering his wife and her lover (golf pro Glenn Quentin), sentenced to two life terms at Shawshank State Prison in Maine; Morgan Freeman as Ellis 'Red' Redding, the narrator, a lifer who smuggles goods; Bob Gunton as Warden Samuel Norton, a corrupt Bible-quoting warden; Clancy Brown as Captain Byron Hadley, brutal chief guard; William Sadler as Heywood; James Whitmore as Brooks Hatlen, the old librarian with a pet crow (Jake) who is paroled after 50 years and hangs himself; Mark Rolston as Bogs Diamond, leader of 'the Sisters' who assault Andy; Gil Bellows as Tommy Williams, a young thief who knows the real killer (Elmo Blatch) and is shot by Hadley on Norton's orders. Story: Andy asks Red for a rock hammer and a Rita Hayworth poster; tar roof work, Andy gives Hadley tax advice and wins beer for the crew; Andy does guards' taxes, builds the library by writing letters to the state senate for six years; plays Mozart's Marriage of Figaro over the PA and gets two weeks in the hole; Norton's 'Inside-Out' labor scheme and money laundering via a fake identity 'Randall Stephens'; after Tommy's murder Andy spends a month in solitary; talks with Red about Zihuatanejo and the Pacific; one stormy night Andy escapes through a tunnel dug behind the posters (Raquel Welch now) over 19 years and crawls 500 yards through a sewer pipe; withdraws Norton's money as Randall Stephens and sends the ledger to the newspaper; Hadley is arrested, Norton shoots himself; Red is paroled after 40 years, follows Andy's letter under the oak tree at a hayfield wall in Buxton, crosses the border and reunites with Andy on a beach in Zihuatanejo, Mexico.
